How does the NFL playoff picture look entering Week 9 of the 2026 season? PFN's Jacob Infante breaks down the AFC and NFC playoff races, examining division leaders, wild-card contenders, and the biggest storylines shaping the postseason outlook. In the AFC, Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills lead the conference, while the New England Patriots, Jacksonville Jaguars, Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Pittsburgh Steelers, and Cincinnati Bengals remain key teams to watch. Meanwhile, the NFC features several competitive division races, including a loaded NFC North with the Minnesota Vikings, Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, and Green Bay Packers all battling for playoff positioning. The San Francisco 49ers currently lead the NFC West, while the Seattle Seahawks and Los Angeles Rams look to close the gap. Can the New York Giants hold onto their surprising NFC East lead? Which teams will emerge from the crowded NFC South? And could the AFC North produce multiple playoff contenders? Infante examines the standings, division races, and potential playoff scenarios as the second half of the NFL season approaches.
